review_text: The staff went above and beyond during our anniversary stay. The room was spotless and the view of the harbor was incredible. Will definitely be back!
Check-in took over 45 minutes even though we had a reservation, and the air conditioning in our room barely worked. Disappointing for the price we paid.
Great location close to downtown, comfortable bed, but the breakfast options were pretty limited and the elevator was out of service for two days.
Found hair in the bathroom and the room smelled of smoke despite booking a non-smoking room. Asked to move rooms and was told none were available.
Best hotel stay we've had in years. The concierge recommended a fantastic restaurant and even helped us get a same-day reservation. Five stars all around.
